title: Possible a Digest authentication response in an Authorization header in source
description: The file contains a Digest authentication response in an Authorization header. Header values are copied into clients, tests and proxy configuration, so a committed one authorises every reader until it is revoked. Shape-only: the match does not prove the token is live.
remediation: Revoke the token at the service, replace the literal header with a value loaded at run time from a secret manager, and check client bundles and logs for the same value.
limitation: Shape-only, case-insensitive match on a specific header name followed by a token-shaped value. It cannot prove the token is valid, and it does not see headers assembled dynamically.

tests.line: Authorization: Digest username="ops", realm="internal", nonce="QQQQQQQQQQQQ", uri="/api", response="deadbeefaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
# Digest auth is negotiated at run time
